study_role: Prospective reproducibility replay of previously explored public datasets. This is not a new blind confirmatory study, externally preregistered trial, geological discovery, or human usability experiment.

gravity.scope: Published disturbance plus explicit land slab recipe. No field validation of full terrain, tides or atmospheric corrections. Southern Africa horizontal datum is unspecified by publisher; no reprojection applied.

magnetic.scope: Periodic FFT, no detrend, taper or padding. Reference Harmonica independently constructs transfers. Directions are declared numerical stress cases, not recovered acquisition parameters.

multilevel.boundary: natural variational boundary of discrete Hessian energy
multilevel.constraints: Briggs curvature constraints at actual observation coordinates

variational.boundary: natural variational boundary of discrete Hessian energy
variational.constraints: second-order Taylor constraints at actual observation coordinates
variational.solver: sparse KKT LU with iterative refinement

interpolation.scope: Interpolation diagnostics on a withheld block of an already interpolated public grid. Finite-output and declared solver-convergence checks only; no predeclared scientific accuracy acceptance and no raw-survey ground truth.

terrain.scope: ETOPO1 coastal DEM projected to a finite Cartesian model. Independent Geoana prism reference, explicit upward/downward and SI/mGal conversion. Bounds cover tree truncation only. Airy finite and periodic conditions checked separately; no geologically calibrated isostatic residual.

survey.scope: All digitized rows; sample-domain smoothing split by published contiguous IDs. Irregular contour samples are not treated as uniformly spaced distance or time.

importer_warnings: Detection uses a limited sample. Review the physical line numbers, names and types before importing.
Sectioned XYZ suggested: slash-prefixed channel header, Line/Tie marker comments and '*' nulls. Review these settings; section markers do not create a missing line channel or assign a CRS.
radiometry.scope: Published corrected concentrations only. No inverse recovery of undocumented calibration coefficients, no validation of atmospheric radon correction. Archive/report label and date channels are recorded as published, without repairing their discrepancy.

limits: No calibrated airborne paired-detector radon field reference was validated.
No independent field truth for minimum-curvature or inverse geological models.

protocol.split: Every fifth station withheld in file order, before fitting
protocol.scope: Coarse-mesh predictive end-to-end test on downloaded observations, not exact tutorial replication or geological recovery
protocol.source_note: Gravity prose says 2.5 percent but executable tutorial code says 2 percent; follows the code explicitly
